verdict.rationale: stagewise automatically generates a WORKSPACE.md when a workspace is connected and calls it the primary way the agent understands the project at a high level, and its agent can read files across workspaces on its own, so no manual context selection is needed. The evidence does not show the agent producing a full codebase map or explanation for the user, and nothing shows how deep WORKSPACE.md goes on large unfamiliar repos. Missing for 10: documented codebase-explanation/mapping workflow for users, detail on WORKSPACE.md contents and depth, hands-on or independent corroboration on large codebases.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files

citations.quote: When you connect a workspace, stagewise generates a WORKSPACE.md file in .stagewise/. This is the primary way the agent understands your project at a high level
AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces
The agent can read and edit files, run shell commands, interact with browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate complex multi-step workflows.
